sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavily favored against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive in poor form with only a single win in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a match where the visitors will need to bounce back from their own recent defeat. The title race could tighten if Stafford capitalise, as they sit just two points behind Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form after recent wins, travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between two competitive mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and carrying momentum, face Wednesfield Community at home seeking to maintain their winning streak. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a clash of evenly-matched sides, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter in dire form having lost their last six games consecutively. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a meeting of mid-table sides both seeking consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a basement-battle between two of the division's poorest performers, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in another fixture between struggling sides. Finally, Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, who remain pointless at the bottom with just two draws from seven matches.
